decision: Keep production scan: measured default-capacity miss improvement does not offset a repeatable single-thread warm-hit regression and additional retention. Preserve probes and correctness fixtures for future evaluation.

public.limitations: Fixed fixtures include negative matches: matched_keys is explicit. Scopes count requested allocator bytes, not RSS. Initial scope includes cold matching, cache population and selected output Vec; FontCollection allocation lies outside it. Timing and allocation use separate binaries; allocator timings are not performance evidence. Parallel per-process worker latency and aggregate elapsed values are retained. Original parallel timer bug found during independent review; old parallel series is preserved only under invalidated_parallel. Official parallel entries use readiness/release/completion barriers and corrected binaries. Original serial entries are unaffected.

invalidated_parallel.reason: Original main timer started after releasing workers and can undercount execution. These values must not be used for parallel throughput or acceptance.

corrected_parallel.protocol: Worker readiness barrier excludes prepare/warmup. Main starts timer, release barrier, completion barrier. All worker durations must fit within aggregate elapsed.

lock_acquisition_diagnostic.limitations: Instrumented one-pass proxy across setup, warmup, and samples. Includes uncontended acquisition and Instant/recording overhead; not pure blocked wait or lock-hold duration. Its timing outputs are not production throughput measurements. Fix is the original direct-heap candidate, not later trial variants. Diagnostic parallel output.elapsed_ns uses the old aggregate timer and is invalid even as a throughput proxy; acquisition counters/durations are separately measured and remain diagnostic data.

outline.interpretation: Exploratory only; variant did not remove the single-thread warm-hit cost. Parallel aggregate throughput values in these exploratory trials use the old invalid timer and are not evidence; serial values are unaffected.

Parallel aggregate throughput values in these exploratory trials use the old invalid timer and are not evidence; serial values are unaffected.

candidate.description: Capacity <256: scan; capacity >=256: bounded lower-bound heap; identical atomic hits, generation invalidation and intern scan. Candidate test artifact includes an expanded collision fixture added after the historical full-workspace run. Expanded collision artifact matching tests passed separately, as recorded in candidate-final-matching-tests.log.

review_fix.finding: Main parallel timer started after release barrier; moving it before the only barrier would also include warmup.
review_fix.correction: Add readiness barrier, then start master timer before worker release barrier, followed by completion barrier. Assert every worker duration fits aggregate duration. Rerun all 3 parallel cases with 5 alternating process pairs / 15 samples per revision.
